entry_points.text: Pstore backend open/close session, read fills rec, write consumes, user-write adds uptr, erase.
Ptdump callbacks per level for entries/flush/prot decode; host observes without owning walk.
Disabled PTP register null, unregister ok, schedule ENOTSUP.
Relay subbuf-start on switch incl null-prev, 1 continue/0 stop, may reserve head; create/remove mandatory.

exports.text: Fallback platform status/init and generic dispatch report no-device without HW touch.
Fallback blob copy fails invalid, firmware alloc returns null, reclaim reports no-device.
PTP events alarm, ext-ts, offset, kernel/user PPS; disabled vclock lookup returns zero.
Bounded u32 uses multiply-reject to avoid bias with pow2 fast path; trivial ceiling zero.
RAS/RAID stubs inert: consumer count zero, addr convert invalid, setup noop.
Stub regulator get returns null; exclusive reports missing device.
Voltage tolerance tries narrow then wider window; support spans expanded interval.
Skip helper advances cursor without store; user copy validates handler/range then forwards.
Relay write appends at offset with subbuf switch on overflow; reserve returns ptr or null.
Resource iter walks all via arch accessor; capable-filtered form skips incapable entries.
Writable-exec check gated by config else noop; PTI init empty.

hazards.text: Size bidir lens pre-call else trunc; validate/copy blobs; alloc may fail; nonce unique; trace bits lost.
Bounded rand needs non-zero ceil; range len underflows if end<start; membuf discards excess; check PTP null/neg.
Skip before start and reserve at/over capacity trigger BUG; callers must guarantee preconditions.

invariants.text: Packing used; addrs 64b with 32b lens; handles 32b, SNP ctx 64b GPA.
PSP buffer PA translation has two build variants: encryption-aware vs direct mapping.
Two builds pack CPU id into addr low bits or timestamp low bits.
Scaled-ppm convert offsets by one then 125/8000 via 64b; adjust adds/subtracts by sign.
System-ts capture helpers null-tolerant, sample only stored clock id.
Blocking bytes wait for seed then fill; latent entropy uses CPU value or empty.
Kstack offset from per-CPU RNG masked to small aligned range, pinned vs optimization.
Rate-limited warnings eval cond once, emit only if gate allows; alt build warns directly.
Regset copyin bounds range, advances ptrs, faults on bad addr; user copy checks faults/size then delegates.
Stub enable/bulk-enable report success; voltage query reports invalid.
Subbuf reservation sets offset to caller len which must stay below capacity-1.
Domain header valid only if stored category/level match expected, else warn-once.

locks.text: Pstore staging guarded by raw spinlock; read traversal serialized by mutex open-close.
Ratelimit init sets lock/interval/burst; interval reset under irqsave.
Ref-tracker init prepares lists/lock/budget/live; disabled build empty.
Relay write masks irqs or pins CPU around current-CPU buffer update.

state_machines.text: Plat init->op->shutdown; guest launch->active; mig out/in starts; SNP launch mirrors.
Ratelimit uninit->armed full burst, consume/miss count, new window after interval, optional release report.
Relay offset fills subbuf then switch; produced/consumed counters hand off writer/reader.

structs.text: Classic SEV plat 1-13, guest 32-35, launch 48-54, out-mig 64-68, in-mig 80-83, dbg 96-97; SNP 129-213 grouped.
SNP page kinds 1-6; shutdown cap bit1; mitigation subcmds status0/verify1.
Plat init: flags+rsvd+mem addr/len; ext adds total len+NV addr/len; SNP-ext uses bit reqs+list ptr+max ASID.
Cert/fw xfer addr+len pairs; CSR/fw single, import double with rsvd; some lens update.
Classic guest ctrl by 32b handle; SNP uses 64b GPA ctx with ASID/status.
Launch start hdl+policy+cert/session and measure bidir-len; SNP start ctx+policy+freq, finish ctx+IDs+hostdata.
Mig out/in starts carry hdl/policy plus cert/session pointer-length groups.
Debug hdl+src/dst+len; attest hdl+report+16B nonce+bidir len; SNP guest-req uses GPA ctx+bufs.
SNP range base+count+rsvd in counted list; reclaim GPA; feature query len+sel+out PA.
PSP msg low16 status, next8 cmd, response top; doorbell reuses cmd, bit0 ring.
Pstore kinds log0,mce1,console2,ftrace3,plat4-6/8,msg7; DMESG flag single-bit; CPU packed in ts.
Record backend+kind+id+ts+buf/len+ECC+priv+cnt+reason+part+compr; backend owner/name/buf/flags; ftrace IP/caller/ts.
Ptdump bounds walk with start/end interval plus state holding active interval.
PTP req selects ext-ts/per-out/PPS with payload for first two; sys-ts pairs pre/post snaps+clockid; name 32B.
PTP info owner/name/maxadj/counts/PPS/caps/pins plus callbacks; event cat+chan+ts/offset/pps.
Interval inclusive u64 start/end; len span+1; contains enclose; overlaps cross.
Ratelimit block spinlock+interval/burst+atomics+flags+window start; default 5 units/10 msgs.
Ref-tracker dir enabled lock+budget+counts+live+lists+class; disabled empty.
Membuf cursor ptr+remain with clamp/advance; regset r/w/active/writeback+geometry+note; view aggregates.
Modes invalid0/fast1/normal2 bitmask-combinable; error flag single-bit; bulk/pre-change as named.
Relay v7; stats full0/large1+counters; per-CPU buf anchors+progress+ref/stats/pages/pad/cpu; chan sizing+topo+name; 3 cbs.
Resctrl default CLOS/RMID 0, any-CPU -1, MBA max U32; levels L3/L2/MBA/SMBA/PERF; CDP none/code/data.
Domain hdr links+id+cat+level+mask; ctrl ext hdr+pseudo+staged+bandwidth; staged val+pending; pseudo schema/geometry.
Purgatory hash addr+len; RAID6 min 4 disks; RAS ATL addr/block/CPU; reciprocal mult+shifts.
